### Community Demos​


Recorded demos shared by the community. Thank you to every team who contributed a video.


#### [Everself](https://everself.com/)​


Orbit, a custom EHR that puts every prescription, note, message, lab, and smart scale reading on one chronological patient timeline for longitudinal obesity care. Read the[case study](https://www.medplum.com/blog/everself-case-study) .


#### [Sandy Health](https://www.sandyhealth.com/)​


Revenue capture for clinics and hospitals: an ambient scribe drafts the clinical note and codes, then writes both back into Medplum.


#### [Profile Health](https://profilehealth.com/)​


Actionable genomics for clinicians: a patient's whole genome fused with a lifetime of records and handed to the physician before the visit. Read the[case study](https://www.medplum.com/blog/profile-case-study) .


#### [Pelairo](https://pelairo.com/)​


A modern laboratory information system (LIS) for pathology labs, built on Medplum.


#### [Vinta Software](https://www.vintasoftware.com/)​


AI Concierge, an AI assistant built on Medplum.


#### [Awell](https://www.awellhealth.com/)​


Panels, a work surface where care teams define a patient population, configure how they work it, and trigger what happens next. Read the[case study](https://www.medplum.com/blog/awell-panels-case-study) .


#### [Teaching EHR](https://github.com/xprimarycare/xpc-emr)​


An open-source, AI-enabled EHR designed for clinical education, built by Paulius Mui, MD and Misha Manulis of[Distillemr](https://distillemr.com/) with Medplum and[PhenoML](https://phenoml.com/) . Read[An EHR That Teaches](https://www.medplum.com/blog/an-ehr-that-teaches) .


For recordings, slides, demos, and photos from last year, see[PlumCon 2025 Materials](https://www.medplum.com/blog/plumcon-2025-materials) .
